# Draft:Kingdom of the Sun by HP Nero

Kingdom of Sun is a 2025 fantasy novel by HP Nero. It is the first book in the Hollow Crown Series.
Plot
}}
Mirage lives in a world divided between mortals and Tessiah — beings gifted with forbidden powers. As the daughter of a cruel king, she is bartered away like cattle, thrust into the hands of mysterious emissary from a mythical kingdom, where magic flows freely, and nothing is as it seems.
With an impending conflict on the horizon, Mirage must navigate an intoxicating world of intrigue, dangerous alliances, and forbidden desires. As dark forces close in, she will learn the cost of power.
Setting
The story takes place across multiple kingdoms in a fantasy world where Gods directly interact with mortals. The world is inhabited by several distinct races.
Kingdoms
* The Eleventh – A kingdom ruled by Kaneira, serving as a realm where magical beings are safe from persecution. Features multiple courtyards representing eternal seasons.
* The Tenth – The primary home of Mirage Darakyn. A Kingdom notorious for the brutal murders of Tessiah.
* The Dreadwood (also called The Fang) – A dangerous magical forest between kingdoms
Characters
Main Characters
* Diana – Secondary protagonist, Winter-Kissed
* Hiver / Snow – Diana's brother, Winter-Kissed
* Mirage – Primary protagonist, Autumn-Kissed
* Dracar – Mirage's brother, Autumn-Kissed Tessiah
* Kaneira – Diana and Hiver's mother, a powerful Drakkarias who rules the Eleventh
* Jesper - Supporting character, Autumn-Kissed
Gods and Goddesses
* Rainier – God of the Moon, Justice, and Shadows; brother to Kyren and Olym
* Arudia – Goddess of Flame, War, and Passion
* Kyren – Goddess of the Silk; the Flesh Weaver who created humanity
* Olym – God of the Sun; father to all Drakkarias; brother to Kyren and Rainier
* Celeste – Goddess of the Stars; grants power over time
* Sabaa – The Three-Faced God of Curses
* Anathena – Blessed by Kyren to weave flesh for Gods, create magical armor and fabrics
* Tiethe - Goddess of the Wild, Wind, Truth, and the Hunt.
* Skadira - Goddess of Shadows
Magical Races
Tessiah
The primary magical race, created by the Gods Rainier and Olym as an improved version of humanity. Tessiah possess various powers based on their type and birth season.
Types of Tessiah:
* Frostwalkers – Damned Tessiah who have killed their own. They have the ability to observe and bind souls.
* Ikeer – Rare Tessiah with necromantic powers; can raise and control the dead (Keer).
* Seaura – Tessiah with powers corresponding to their birth season.
* Veritongue - Shapeshifters who are bound to tell only the truth.
* Bargainers - Mortals who make risky gambits with the Gods in exchange for power.
Drakkarias
Dragons entrapped in human flesh, all God-Born with Olym as their father. Possess dragon-fire abilities and can transform. Considered near-immortal and can only be killed by Talis items.
God-Born
Individuals with direct divine parentage, possessing God's blood. More resilient than normal Tessiah and cannot be killed by conventional means.
Divine Artifacts
Talis Items
Sacred artifacts that are the only weapons capable of killing God-Born or Gods:
* '''Arakos's Star
* The Shard of Aetheris
* Death’s Chalice
* The Eternal Harp
* Veil of Phantasm'''
Divine Concepts
Vesseling
The process by which a God inhabits a mortal's body, typically through Solathrix (A form of heavily guarded magic). The God gains control while being able to read the vessel's thoughts.
Taking Flesh
The creation of a physical, human-like body for a God by Anathena or Kyren's blessed.
Favor
A divine blessing where a Tessiah trades their natural abilities for God-given powers, creating a permanent bond with the deity.
Rippling
A form of divine teleportation that feels like being torn apart. Used by Gods and some powerful beings.
Themes
The novel explores several interconnected themes:
* Divine justice and consequence – Every use of divine power requires payment
* Identity and autonomy – Characters struggle with possession and control
* Family bonds – Both blood family and chosen family relationships
* Power and responsibility – The burden of magical abilities
* Mortality and immortality – The line between life, death, and undeath
* Creation and failure – The Gods' repeated attempts to create perfect beings
Mirage must reconcile her new identity as both a Tessiah magic-user and a scion of the Goddess of War. As she learns to control her powers, she is embraced by the Eleventh Kingdom and begins to forge new bonds. However, her twin brother Dracar remains trapped under their father's rule in the Tenth Kingdom.
When Jesper, a vengeful Tessiah from the Eleventh, convinces Mirage to return home and rescue Dracar, more secrets spill from the castle walls like stale wine, and it will stain Mirage's consciousness for all of eternity.
World-Building
The Eternal Gardens
The afterlife realm where souls reside after death. When someone is raised as Keer, their soul is torn from the Gardens and cannot easily return without Arakos's Star.
Order of the Solarian
An organization that tests Tessiah children for dangerous powers like the Ikeer, believing such abilities had died out evolutionarily.

Quotes

favorite color is sage green, I know your favorite flower is the
violet, I know you have nightmares almost every night, I know you
have…fits…you can’t control—I have seen you. I know you.”
― HP Nero, Kingdom of the Sun
“I wanted his words, his admission, his guilt laid bare before me.
I wouldn’t ask, though, He would need to offer it to me.
I needed his confession.”
― HP Nero, Kingdom of the Sun

the light would seek to burn us alive.”
― HP Nero, Kingdom of the Sun

rage, with anguish.”
